title: The Arm of the Postal Service
prompt: One day a man received a parcel in the post. Carefully packed inside was a human arm. He examined it, repacked it and sent it on to another man. The second man also examined the arm carefully before taking it to the woods and burying it. Why did they do this?
solution: Three men had been stranded on a desert island. Desperate for food, they agreed to amputate their left arms and eat them, and swore an oath that each would have his left arm cut off. One of them was a doctor and he cut off the arms of his two companions. They were then rescued, but his oath was still binding, so he later had his own arm amputated and sent it to one of his companions, who examined it and sent it on to the other, who buried it.
